svg.text: What we go for, and in what order
Five missions, one Level Up, 2:30 on the clock.
We split the work into three sequences so two of
us can run tools at once instead of queueing for
Our table, set up for a full run
M01 pays 20 a token for keystone species parked in
a microbiome, three to a microbiome. M04 opens the
nest and the hollow tree to release them. One
attachment, one loop, run under program.
M03 pays 5 every time a token goes through the
waterfall — and it comes back. 50 cycles is the
biggest points pool on the table. Lift tower,
one-way door grabber, a rope loop.
M02 Roots of Renewal: resources cycled up the
tree, 5 a time at the base and more in the canopy.
The grand tree motor is the Specialist’s, so this
one never stops the driving base.
Still to measure: how long one waterfall loop takes.
That number picks the sequence we run.

locks on, so we only have to get close.
